title: Delivery Governance and Performance Visibility
summary: Improved delivery reliability by connecting project governance, resource planning, performance data, and financial visibility.

projectItems.title: Integrated Project Governance and Delivery System
projectItems.summary: A standardised toolkit for project tracking, documentation, issue resolution, reporting, and accountability.
projectItems.problemStatement: Projects lacked consistent controls, creating uneven execution and weak traceability.
projectItems.solution: Designed connected tools and standard workflows across the project lifecycle.
projectItems.impact: Improved delivery consistency, coordination, tracking, and issue visibility across teams.
projectItems.leadershipValue: Demonstrates the ability to build governance systems that scale across teams.

projectItems.title: Project Pulse
projectItems.summary: A dashboard for project financial health, resource utilisation, transactions, budgets, and profitability signals across entities.
projectItems.problemStatement: Financial and delivery reviews depended on fragmented checks and runtime API calls that reduced reliability.
projectItems.solution: Moved dashboard retrieval to processed BV Pulse datasets supported by scheduled synchronisation, validation, and access controls.
projectItems.impact: Improved dashboard responsiveness and management visibility; the case study estimates 191.25 hours of monthly saving across 45 users.
projectItems.leadershipValue: Connects data architecture choices directly to the speed and quality of operating decisions.

projectItems.title: Resource Planning and Timesheet Approval
projectItems.summary: A multi-role system that connects weekly planning, manager review, correction, approval, and Zoho Projects time-log posting.
projectItems.problemStatement: Spreadsheet planning and manual follow-up obscured workload, submission status, and usable capacity.
projectItems.solution: Built role-specific planning, review, approval, business-vertical, and project-lead dashboards around a shared weekly record.
projectItems.impact: Created one controlled workflow for engineers and managers, with clearer loading and utilisation visibility for leaders.
projectItems.leadershipValue: Shows end-to-end operating model design from frontline execution to management oversight.
